title: XLN Treasure Chest: card flavor text

entities.name: Adrian Adanto
entities.description: A conquistador of Lujio who claims land in the name of the queen.

entities.name: Azcanta
entities.description: A sunken ruin housing all the learning of a long-forgotten age.

entities.name: Arguel
entities.description: A man whose vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan to a lost temple.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane with jungles where lost temples lie.

entities.name: Temple of Aclazotz
entities.description: The lost temple of a bat-god of night in the jungles of Ixalan.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: A bat-god of night, eternal enemy to the Threefold Sun.

entities.name: Threefold Sun
entities.description: A solar deity, eternal enemy of the bat-god of night.

entities.name: Ripley Vance
entities.description: A pirate captain who carved cliffs with cannon fire to form a fortress home.

entities.name: Spitfire Bastion
entities.description: The fortress Ripley Vance commands, carved from the cliffs.

entities.name: Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun
entities.description: Land blessed with fertility by humans and merfolk before the Sun Empire was born.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: An empire whose birth came after humans and merfolk blessed the land.

entities.name: Lost Vale
entities.description: A place in the interior where pirates seeking treasure found something far greater.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who studies a compass pointing toward a cryptic objective.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: A compass that Jace says indicates an aetheric azimuth.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: A place with spires described as a cryptic objective.

events.summary: Adrian Adanto claims land in the name of the queen.
events.quote: "I claim this land in the name of the queen."

events.summary: Arguel's vision leads him into the jungles of Ixalan to the lost Temple of Aclazotz.
events.quote: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan ...

events.summary: Captain Vance carves the cliffs with a broadside assault to form her new home, a fortress she now commands instead of a ship.
events.quote: With a broadside assault, Captain Vance carved the cliffs to form her new home.

events.summary: In the distant past, before the Sun Empire, humans and merfolk joined magic to bless the land with fertility.
events.quote: Before the Sun Empire was born, humans and merfolk joined their magic to invoke a blessing of fertility on the land.

events.summary: Jace Beleren interprets the Thaumatic Compass as pointing toward a cryptic objective.
events.quote: "Clearly, it indicates the aetheric azimuth of ..."

relations.quote: ... to the lost temple of a bat-god of night, eternal enemy to the Threefold Sun.
Now instead of a ship, Ripley Vance commands a fortress.
Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan ...

rejected.summary: Pirates venture into the interior for treasure and find something far greater.
rejected.quote: The pirates had ventured into the interior for treasure. They found something far greater.
